description:
Use this when you need someone's Chinese zodiac sign and element from a Gregorian birth date, especially for January–February births where the boundary matters, or the sign's traditional compatibility groups. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a full Bazi chart with month, day and hour pillars (use bazi-four-pillars), or the Western star sign (use zodiac).
What it computes: Finds the Chinese zodiac animal (生肖 shengxiao), sexagenary year (干支 ganzhi), stem element, yin/yang, nayin (纳音) and fixed element for a birth date, using either the Chinese New Year boundary or the 立春 (Lichun) boundary, plus the traditional relationship groups (六合, 三合, 六冲, 六害, 相刑) and 本命年 years.
Inputs: birth_date (date); boundary (enum, optional); reference_year (integer, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"birth_date":"1990-02-10","boundary":"lunar_new_year","reference_year":2026} | {"birth_date":"1990-02-03","boundary":"lichun"}
Outputs: zodiac, zodiac_cn, year_ganzhi, year_ganzhi_pinyin, year_english, stem_element, yin_yang, nayin, animal_fixed_element, year_used, chinese_new_year_date, lichun_datetime, boundary_note, benmingnian_years, secret_friend, trine_partners, clash, harm, punishment, age_in_reference_year [years], is_benmingnian_in_reference_year, reference_year_zodiac.
Formula: year_used = Gregorian year, minus 1 when birth_date is before Chinese New Year (or before 立春 with boundary = lichun); ganzhi index = (year_used − 4) mod 60; animal = branch = index mod 12; 六合 partner = (13 − b) mod 12; 三合 = b ± 4; 六冲 = b + 6; 六害 partner = (7 − b) mod 12
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/chinese-zodiac with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/lunar/chinese-zodiac.md

birth_date.description: Gregorian birth date (civil date in China Standard Time), 1900–2100.

boundary.description: Which event starts the zodiac year: Chinese New Year (popular usage, default) or 立春 around 4 February (astrological usage).

reference_year.description: Optional Gregorian year for which to report the age and whether it is a 本命年.

name: find_chinese_zodiac

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

age_in_reference_year.description: Age reached on the birthday in reference_year (reference_year − Gregorian birth year); only when reference_year is given. Unit: years.

animal_fixed_element.description: Element of the earthly branch: Rat Water, Ox Earth, Tiger Wood, Rabbit Wood, Dragon Earth, Snake Fire, Horse Fire, Goat Earth, Monkey Metal, Rooster Metal, Dog Earth, Pig Water.

benmingnian_years.description: Zodiac years of the same animal from the birth year to birth year + 96, with their ganzhi.

boundary_note.description: Whether the birth date fell before or after the chosen boundary, and what the other convention would give.

chinese_new_year_date.description: Date of 正月初一 in the Gregorian year of birth.

is_benmingnian_in_reference_year.description: true when the zodiac year numbered reference_year has the same animal as the birth year; only when reference_year is given.

lichun_datetime.description: Instant of 立春 in the Gregorian year of birth (China Standard Time).

nayin.description: Nayin melodic element of the year ganzhi.

punishment.description: Punishment partners: 寅巳申 and 丑戌未 groups, the 子卯 pair, or self-punishment (自刑) for 辰午酉亥.

reference_year_zodiac.description: Ganzhi and animal of the year numbered reference_year; only when reference_year is given.

stem_element.description: Element of the heavenly stem with its character.

trine_partners.description: The two other signs of the same triangle of affinity.

year_english.description: Stem element and animal, e.g. Metal Horse.

year_used.description: Year number the birth date was assigned to under the chosen boundary.

yin_yang.description: Polarity of the stem (and branch) of the year.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Chinese Zodiac Calculator (生肖)
